questions.question: Tailwind CSS là gì và approach nào khác với CSS thông thường?

options.A: Tailwind là CSS framework với pre-built components
options.B: Tailwind là utility-first CSS framework — build designs bằng cách compose small utility classes trực tiếp trong HTML, không cần custom CSS files

questions.explanation: Utility-first: <div class='flex items-center gap-4 p-6 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md'> thay vì viết .card { display: flex; align-items: center; }. Advantages: (1) No naming fatigue (không cần đặt tên class). (2) Consistent design system (spacing, colors are standardized). (3) JIT: chỉ generate CSS cho classes được dùng → tiny bundle. (4) Responsive: md:flex, lg:grid. (5) Dark mode: dark:bg-gray-900. (6) Hover/focus: hover:bg-blue-600, focus:ring. v4: CSS-first config thay vì tailwind.config.js.

questions.question: Tailwind responsive design — breakpoints hoạt động thế nào?

options.B: Mobile-first breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px), 2xl (1536px); prefix class với breakpoint: md:flex-row

questions.explanation: Mobile-first approach: base style = mobile. Add breakpoint prefix để override ở larger sizes. <div class='flex flex-col md:flex-row'>: column trên mobile, row từ md+. Custom breakpoints trong tailwind.config.js: screens: { 'tablet': '640px', 'laptop': '1024px' }. Tailwind v4: @custom-media --md (width >= 768px). Container: class='container mx-auto px-4' — max-width per breakpoint. Arbitrary: min-[320px]:text-center, max-md:hidden.

questions.question: Tailwind dark mode implementation?

options.B: dark: prefix với variant: 'class' (toggle via JS class) hoặc 'media' (system preference); dark:bg-gray-900, dark:text-white
options.C: Phải viết CSS media queries riêng
options.D: Dark mode chỉ với Tailwind UI

questions.explanation: Config: darkMode: 'class' (recommended for user control) hoặc 'media' (CSS prefers-color-scheme). Class mode: thêm/bỏ class 'dark' trên <html> element. <div class='bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-gray-900 dark:text-white'>. Toggle: document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark'). localStorage: persist preference. Tailwind v4: built-in, @variant dark {} in CSS. System default: darkMode: ['class', '[data-theme="dark"]'] cho custom selectors.

questions.question: Tailwind customization — extend vs override config?

options.B: extend: thêm values vào default theme; override: replace default values; tailwind.config.js theme.extend cho additional colors, spacing, fonts

questions.explanation: tailwind.config.js: module.exports = { theme: { extend: { colors: { brand: { 50: '#eff6ff', 500: '#3b82f6', 900: '#1e3a5f' } }, fontFamily: { sans: ['Inter', ...defaultTheme.fontFamily.sans] }, spacing: { '18': '4.5rem', '88': '22rem' } } } }. Override (replace default): theme.colors (không extend) → removes all default colors. Arbitrary values: bg-[#1da1f2], w-[calc(100%-2rem)]. CSS variables: var(--color-brand-500). Tailwind v4: @theme { --color-brand-500: #3b82f6; } trong CSS file.

questions.question: Tailwind @apply directive — khi nào nên dùng?

options.B: @apply: extract repeating utility patterns vào component CSS — dùng cho highly reused components; tránh dùng quá nhiều vì mất utility-first benefits

questions.explanation: .btn-primary { @apply px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500; }. Khi nên dùng: base HTML elements (a, button, input), shared component styles, third-party HTML. Khi KHÔNG nên: mỗi component (làm mất benefits). Tailwind recommends: dùng component abstractions (React/Vue components) thay @apply. Performance: @apply có thể increase bundle size nếu dùng quá nhiều. Tailwind v4: @apply vẫn support.

questions.question: Tailwind JIT mode và content configuration?

options.A: JIT là optional, mặc định là full CSS
options.B: JIT (Just-in-Time) là mặc định từ v3 — scan content files, chỉ generate CSS cho classes được dùng; content config bắt buộc phải đúng

questions.explanation: tailwind.config.js: content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,vue,svelte}']. JIT: scan files → extract class names → generate only those CSS utilities. Benefits: instant dev builds, smaller CSS bundle (thường < 10KB), all variants always available. Gotcha: class names phải be complete strings (không concatenate): text-${color}-500 → Tailwind không detect. Pattern: const classes = { red: 'text-red-500', blue: 'text-blue-500' }. Safelist: safelist: ['text-red-500'] để force include. v4: content tự detect từ imports.

questions.question: Tailwind plugins — custom utilities và variants?

options.B: plugin() API để thêm custom utilities, components, base styles, variants; official plugins: @tailwindcss/forms, typography, aspect-ratio
options.D: Custom utilities phải viết CSS riêng

questions.explanation: plugins: [plugin(function({ addUtilities, addComponents, addBase, theme, matchUtilities }) { addUtilities({ '.scrollbar-hide': { '-ms-overflow-style': 'none', 'scrollbar-width': 'none', '&::-webkit-scrollbar': { display: 'none' } } }); matchUtilities({ 'tab': (value) => ({ 'tab-size': value }) }, { values: theme('spacing') }) })]. Official: @tailwindcss/typography (prose class), @tailwindcss/forms (form reset), @tailwindcss/aspect-ratio. Community: tailwindcss-animate. Tailwind UI: paid component library. Flowbite, DaisyUI: free component libraries.

questions.question: Class merging với clsx và tailwind-merge — tại sao cần?

options.B: Tailwind classes có thể conflict (p-4 và p-8 cùng apply); tailwind-merge intelligently merge conflicting classes — last-one-wins với proper understanding of Tailwind semantics
options.C: Không cần merge, chỉ dùng class string
options.D: tailwind-merge chỉ dùng cho conditional classes

questions.explanation: Problem: <Button className='p-2 text-sm' className='p-4 text-lg'> → cả p-2 và p-4 đều apply → browser picks based on specificity (unpredictable). tailwind-merge: twMerge('p-2 text-sm', 'p-4') → 'text-sm p-4' (last p wins). clsx: conditional classes với objects/arrays. cn() helper: function cn(...inputs) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)) }. Usage: <button className={cn('px-4 py-2 rounded', variant === 'primary' && 'bg-blue-500', disabled && 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed', className)}>. CVA (class-variance-authority) cho component variants.

questions.question: Implement Tailwind component với variants (button)?

options.B: CVA (class-variance-authority) cho type-safe variants; cn() helper; compound variants; default variants; TypeScript types tự động
options.D: Chỉ một class cho mỗi button

questions.explanation: const button = cva('inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2', { variants: { intent: { primary: 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 focus:ring-blue-500', secondary: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-200', destructive: 'bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700' }, size: { sm: 'h-8 px-3 text-sm', md: 'h-10 px-4 text-sm', lg: 'h-12 px-6 text-base' } }, defaultVariants: { intent: 'primary', size: 'md' } }). type ButtonProps = VariantProps<typeof button> & React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>. export function Button({ intent, size, className, ...props }: ButtonProps) { return <button className={cn(button({ intent, size }), className)} {...props} /> }.

questions.question: Tailwind CSS animations và transitions?

options.B: Built-in: transition, duration, ease utilities; animate-spin, animate-ping, animate-pulse, animate-bounce; custom animations trong tailwind.config.js; @keyframes

questions.explanation: <button class='transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-lg active:scale-95'>. transition-{property}: transition, transition-colors, transition-transform. duration: duration-150, duration-300, duration-500, duration-700. ease: ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out. Custom animation: keyframes: { shimmer: { '0%': { backgroundPosition: '-200% 0' }, '100%': { backgroundPosition: '200% 0' } } }, animation: { shimmer: 'shimmer 1.5s linear infinite' }. tailwindcss-animate plugin: animate-in, fade-in, slide-in-from-right. Reduced motion: motion-reduce:animate-none.

questions.question: Tailwind grid và flexbox layout patterns?

options.B: Flexbox: flex, justify-*, items-*, gap-*, flex-col/row, flex-wrap, flex-1/none. Grid: grid, grid-cols-*, gap, col-span-*, auto-cols, place-items
options.C: Grid và flexbox không thể combine

questions.explanation: Flex card layout: <div class='flex items-center gap-4 p-4'>. Flex fill: <div class='flex-1 min-w-0'><h2 class='truncate'>. Grid: <div class='grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6'>. Masonry-like: grid-cols-3 auto-rows-auto. Auto-fill: grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr))]. Dashboard: <div class='grid grid-cols-12 gap-4'><div class='col-span-12 lg:col-span-8'>main<div class='col-span-12 lg:col-span-4'>sidebar. Sticky sidebar: <div class='grid lg:grid-cols-[320px_1fr]'><aside class='sticky top-0 h-screen'>.

questions.question: Tailwind forms — styling với @tailwindcss/forms plugin?

options.B: @tailwindcss/forms reset browser defaults; styled inputs với ring, border, focus utilities; custom checkbox/radio designs; validation states
options.C: Phải viết CSS form styles thủ công
options.D: Form styling không thể với utility classes

questions.explanation:
@tailwindcss/forms: reset browser form styling để dễ customize. Strategy: class strategy (phải add 'form-input' class) hoặc base (auto-reset). Input: . Error state: +

. Custom checkbox: . Select: appearance-none với custom arrow.

questions.question: Tailwind classes không apply — common causes?

options.A: Tailwind luôn apply tất cả classes
options.B: content config sai (file không được scan), dynamic class concatenation, typos, purged classes; check generated CSS file

questions.explanation: Debug checklist: (1) content config không include file: './src/**/*.jsx' không scan .tsx → add **.{jsx,tsx}**. (2) Dynamic class: const size = 'lg'; return `text-${size}` → text-lg không trong CSS. Fix: whitelist hoặc full class names. (3) Typo: bg-blu-500 → không apply, no error. (4) Specificity: other CSS overrides. Fix: tailwind-merge, order CSS loading. (5) Dev build: check browser CSS (ctrl+shift+i). (6) Inspect với browser DevTools → xem class có trong Computed styles. (7) Check tailwind.config.js content glob patterns với glob visualizer.

questions.question: Tailwind CSS specificity conflicts với custom CSS?

options.B: Tailwind classes đều specificity bằng nhau; custom CSS có thể override hoặc bị override tùy load order; dùng layers để control

questions.explanation: @layer: @tailwind base, components, utilities. Custom CSS trong @layer utilities: { .my-class { @apply ... } } → same specificity as utilities. Order trong CSS: later declarations win (same specificity). Problem: component library inject CSS sau tailwind → override. Fix: tailwind.config.js important: '#app' hoặc important: true. Custom utilities trong @layer: not purged. Inline styles: higher specificity than classes. CSS Modules: scoped but can conflict với global tailwind. Best: use Tailwind for everything, avoid custom CSS khi có thể.

questions.question: Dark mode không toggle — debugging?

options.A: Dark mode auto-works với class strategy
options.B: class strategy: phải add/remove 'dark' class trên <html>; localStorage persistence; system preference detection; SSR hydration mismatch
options.D: Dark mode không work trên mobile

questions.explanation: Debug: (1) darkMode: 'class' trong tailwind.config.js. (2) Toggle: document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark'). (3) Persist: localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark'). (4) Init: trước React hydration: <script>if (localStorage.theme === 'dark' || (!('theme' in localStorage) && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) { document.documentElement.classList.add('dark') }</script>. (5) SSR mismatch: script trong <head> (trước React render). (6) Check: document.documentElement.className có 'dark' không trong DevTools. (7) Selector specificity: dark:bg-gray-900 cần parent có .dark class.

questions.question: Tailwind bundle size quá lớn trong production?

options.B: JIT mode (default v3+) chỉ generate used classes; check content config đúng; safelist items; component libraries import toàn bộ
options.D: CSS size không quan trọng với HTTP/2

questions.explanation: Production Tailwind thường 5-15KB gzipped. Large bundle causes: (1) Safelist quá nhiều patterns. (2) content glob quá rộng → scan files không cần thiết. (3) Component library (shadcn, DaisyUI) include nhiều unused styles. (4) @apply overuse → duplicated CSS. Optimize: (1) Đảm bảo JIT mode. (2) content chính xác. (3) Tránh safelist regex: { pattern: /.*/, }. (4) cssnano để minify. (5) gzip/brotli compression trên server. (6) Analyze: PurgeCSS stats hoặc PostCSS analyze.

questions.question: Tailwind design system với Storybook cho team?

options.B: Tailwind tokens → CSS variables; Storybook với Tailwind integration; design tokens sync với Figma; component variants với CVA; documentation
options.C: Chỉ cần design file là đủ

questions.explanation: Setup: Storybook với @storybook/addon-styling. tailwind.config.js là source of truth cho design tokens. Figma sync: Figma Variables → tailwind.config.js (manual hoặc tools như Specify, Supernova). Tokens: colors, spacing, typography, shadows từ config. Component: Button.stories.tsx với variants. Documentation: Storybook Autodocs. Visual testing: Chromatic. Dark mode: withThemeByClassName decorator. Theme provider: custom decorator inject 'dark' class cho dark mode stories.

questions.question: shadcn/ui với Tailwind — component library approach?

options.B: shadcn/ui: copy-paste components (không npm install), fully customizable, Radix UI primitives, TypeScript, CVA variants, accessible

questions.explanation: shadcn/ui philosophy: bạn OWN components, không install library. npx shadcn-ui@latest add button → copy Button.tsx vào src/components/ui/. Stack: Radix UI (accessibility/behavior) + Tailwind (styling) + CVA (variants). Customize: edit component files trực tiếp. Tailwind v4 setup: npx shadcn@latest init. Components: Button, Input, Dialog, Select, Toast, etc. Why: không bị lock vào library's design decisions, không version conflict, full TypeScript, accessible out of the box. vs Headless UI (từ Tailwind team).

questions.question: Tailwind v4 — major changes và migration?

options.A: Tailwind v4 không có breaking changes
options.B: CSS-first config (@theme in CSS), Vite-first, removed tailwind.config.js, automatic content detection, native CSS variables, new import syntax
options.C: Tailwind v4 chỉ là minor update

questions.explanation: Tailwind v4 breaking changes: (1) CSS-first: @import 'tailwindcss'; @theme { --color-brand: #3b82f6; } trong CSS file. (2) Không cần tailwind.config.js (optional). (3) Automatic content detection — không cần configure content paths. (4) Native CSS variables cho tất cả tokens. (5) New import: @import 'tailwindcss' thay @tailwind base/components/utilities. (6) Vite plugin: @tailwindcss/vite thay PostCSS plugin (optional). (7) Removed: deprecated utilities, JIT là default từ v3. Migration: upgrade guide, codemods available. Dùng v3 cho stable projects cho đến v4 stable.

questions.question: Tailwind với SSR (Next.js) — performance considerations?

options.B: Tailwind CSS fully static — không JS; critical CSS inlining; font optimization; no FOUC (flash of unstyled content); dark mode SSR hydration

questions.explanation: Tailwind advantages với SSR: (1) Pure CSS — không JS runtime, không hydration issues cho styles. (2) Critical CSS: Next.js inline critical CSS tự động cho Tailwind. (3) No FOUC: styles đã có trong server-rendered HTML. (4) Dark mode issue: class strategy cần client JS để read localStorage → FOUC possible. Fix: inline script trong <head> để set class trước hydration. (5) next/font với Tailwind: nhúng fonts, set CSS variables trong tailwind.config.js. (6) Selective hydration: Tailwind classes on RSC components → 0 bytes JS. (7) Build: Tailwind processes CSS at build time → static CSS file.
